bundle.name: ExcelReportPipeline
bundle.author: office-scripts
bundle.purpose: Automate recurring business-report production:  raw data import → Power Query transform → VBA orchestration → formatted Excel report → email/SharePoint distribution.

inputs.description: Raw data feeds accepted by the pipeline. Each source must be resolvable at runtime without manual browse-to-file steps.

requiredFields.enforcedColumns: declared in transform step, not here

rejectionRules.missingColumn: halt with column-error log entry if column is required by a transform

transforms.description: Power Query M scripts for data cleaning and shaping, plus VBA orchestration for workbook-level control.

steps: invoke Power Query refresh with given parameters
post-processing: freeze panes, print area, named ranges

outputs.description: Formatted Excel reports produced by the pipeline.

reportFormat.visibility: Report sheet visible; Data sheet may be hidden or very-hidden

distribution.description: Post-generation delivery surface for the finished report.
distribution.deliveryConfirmation: log entry per distribution attempt with timestamp and outcome

validation.description: Automated checks that prove the pipeline produces a correct report.
preFlight: source file exists and is readable
source file matches expected schema (column presence, not content)
postFlight: output file contains at least one data row in the Report sheet
output file contains the named ranges: ReportTitle, ReportDate, ReportData
output file's ReportData row count matches or exceeds source row count (for non-aggregating reports)
no #REF!, #VALUE!, or #N/A errors on the Report sheet
regression: contract-versioned reference output for diff comparison
row-count stability check across runs with identical input

external.outlook: required for email distribution surface only
external.sharePoint: required for SharePoint distribution surface only
external.databaseDrivers: OLEDB or ODBC driver required for database input source only

haltConditions: input source schema mismatch (columns required by transform are missing)
warnConditions: source has fewer rows than expected threshold
named range creation fails (report still produced)
errorHandling.rollback: no destructive operations; previous output is never overwritten until new output passes postFlight validation

extensionRules.description: How future bundles extend or compose with ExcelReportPipeline.
rules: new input sources may be added without breaking existing transforms
new output sheets may be appended without modifying the Report sheet contract
new distribution surfaces may be added without touching existing ones
transform steps may be appended after the last current step; reordering requires a contract version bump
consumers must not rename or reinterpret core contract fields
consumer-specific workflow state must remain in the consuming bundle
